datasets.name: Pull requests
datasets.source: GitHub REST/GraphQL via gh CLI, read-only backfill
datasets.gaps: Browsable on this site: the 1,000-PR archive plus live lists. Full records older than 6 hours require an API key.

datasets.name: Issues
datasets.source: GitHub via gh CLI, read-only backfill
datasets.coverage: 2,343 of 32,878 issues indexed — backfill in progress
datasets.gaps: Older issues not yet backfilled; the 100 most recently updated open issues are always live.

datasets.name: Ecosystem catalog
datasets.source: plugin-catalog, optional-skills and GitHub topic search
datasets.coverage: 1,113 items — 515 plugins, 375 skills, 55 mods, 134 mcp, 34 tools
datasets.gaps: Free items only, by policy; paid offerings are not listed. Link health: 30 checked, 0 dead, 0 unknown.

datasets.name: Quality corpus
datasets.gaps: Only counts and document titles are public; content requires an API key.

datasets.name: Watch lane
datasets.gaps: Never comments, reviews or reacts on GitHub. Scope: open PRs from the whole maintainer team

datasets.name: Live dashboard state
datasets.coverage: strips, backlog, releases, merge rate, recent issues/PRs, contributors
datasets.gaps: Panels backed by /api/v1/overview update in the browser when the API is newer.

budget.rule: Each JSON shard loaded by the page should stay under 350 KB raw. scripts/perf_gate.py prints the table at the end of every build and warns (never fails) when a shard is over budget.
